title: Chapter 93: Zerg Parasitic Technology
content:
Chapter 93: Zerg Parasitic Technology

The Zerg, who had been paying attention to the battlefield, also found that there were lords gathering here. The Queen of Zerg discovered Niu Kun, who was surrounded by many lords, through the host.

Wu Qing was in a good mood after receiving the news, but he did not disturb Niu Kun and these lords. He just asked the Queen of Zerg to focus on Niu Kun's safety.

"Meng, the Zerg sent a message that the Niu tribe lord Niu Kun is still on the battlefield and alive and well."

Wu Qing said to Meng and others with a smile.

"Haha, that guy is really lucky!"

"It's good that he's fine! I'll have a few drinks with him when I have a chance!"

Meng, Yu Chong, and Bai Yan were also very happy to hear the news.

...

On the battlefield, the Zerg divided the entire battlefield into sections according to the Queen of Zerg's plan, so that it would be convenient for others to clean up the battlefield.

If this battlefield is not cleaned up early, it will be a huge bomb here.

The Tengu tribe must deal with this battlefield as soon as possible, not only for supplies, but more importantly to eliminate the potential dangers of this battlefield.

The Zerg did not stop, fighting various weird things that made people uncomfortable, and gradually cleared the entire battlefield.

Wu Qing watched the battle through the host's vision for a while, and then stopped watching. These weird things, even if they don't attack you, will pollute your spirit if you watch them too much.

Fortunately, other people on the battlefield can't see them.

After a large number of weird things on the battlefield were cleaned up, the Zerg host flew over the battlefield and continued to detect the weird things that slipped through the net.

Wu Qing found that even with the normal protection of the Qiyun formation, under the influence of various negative auras on the battlefield, there will still be some strange weird things that can invade the battlefield.

Fortunately, their attack methods are restricted by the Qiyun formation, and will not cause too much harm, and will soon be discovered and cleared by the Zerg.

"The large-scale weird things on the battlefield have been cleared by the Zerg, and some weird things are constantly invading the battlefield. The Zerg will guard the battlefield tonight."

"Everyone go to rest, there are still many things to do tomorrow."

Seeing that the situation on the battlefield is stable and everyone has been standing here for a long time, Wu Qing asked everyone to go back and rest first.

"Okay! I'm really hungry!"

"Yu Chong, Bai Yan, let's go together and have a drink first!"

"Wu Qing, go do whatever you want, don't worry about us!"

Meng knew that there was nothing they needed to help with now, so he took Yu Chong and Bai Yan to eat and drink.

After a day of fighting, they ate some dry food. Everyone was hungry and tired and needed a good rest to recover.

After Meng and the others left, Wu Qing's Zerg clone stood alone on the wall, and his consciousness had returned to the main body of the Zerg territory.

...

"Queen of Zerg, the 50,000 evil god believers are a good labor force for Daxia Territory. Is there any way to rescue them with the technology that the Zerg has unlocked now?"

When Wu Qing returned to the territory, he began to discuss with the Queen of Zerg about the disposal of the personnel and materials in the seized city.

Supplies are easy to deal with. Daxia Territory is now under construction and all kinds of materials are in short supply. Just find a way to transport them back.

The nearly 50,000 logistic personnel of the evil god camp are not easy to deal with. Killing them directly can obtain a lot of system resources, but Wu Qing feels it is a pity. Killing them is like killing the chicken to get the eggs.

If Daxia Territory has these 50,000 personnel, the construction speed will take off, and Daxia Territory will soon become one of the most powerful territories in the region.

The luck and reputation brought by this can provide a steady stream of resources for the system, which is far more cost-effective than this one-time transaction.

"With the technology unlocked now, there is no way to rescue those fanatical evil god believers. For these evil god believers in a self-enclosed state, we can give it a try."

"But if you want them to fully recover to normal, it is not possible with the current level of technology."

The Queen of Insects thought for a while before replying to Wu Qing.

"What technology should we use? It would be best if we can come up with a design tonight and conduct the test tomorrow morning."

"Don't worry about it. These people who have been contaminated by the evil god's belief are equivalent to being dead. Whatever the result of the rescue is, it is acceptable."

Wu Qing knew that the Queen of Zerg was not a pure Zerg mindset now, but an impure Zerg mindset influenced by Wu Qing's mindset. Some things had to be taken into consideration when doing them, and Wu Qing needed to delegate authority to her.

"Use parasitic technology."

"Parasitic technology is a skill of the Queen's army. The complete parasitic technology requires the mother nest to be upgraded to a higher form, and it can only be fully unlocked after the Queen's nest building is built."

"Parasitic technology is also included in the basic technology of the Zerg. Without the support of the parasites produced by the Queen's army, we can consume resources to create special parasites based on the larvae."

"As long as this parasite can devour and replace part of the brain of an intelligent creature, it can effectively parasitize and control the intelligent creature."

"The Zerg's biotechnology has conducted in-depth research on the brain. Through parasites, the brain that meets the parasitic conditions can be precisely controlled."

The Queen of Zerg explained to Wu Qing.

"Now that we have a direction, let's test and optimize, and bring out the finished product tomorrow morning for actual testing."

Wu Qing gave the Queen a task.

After discussing tomorrow's plans and contingency plans, Wu Qing checked today's harvest alone.

After a series of battles, Wu Qing did not miss any opportunity to obtain energy, which made the system's resources very sufficient.

There are 5,000 Hydralisks and nearly 60,000 Puppies. Wu Qing plans to increase the number of Hydralisks to 6,000 and the number of Puppies to 80,000.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

The number of hosts is sufficient and does not need to be increased.

Two hundred more worker bees were added, increasing the number to 1,000.

The mother nests that affect the speed of Zerg's sudden troops, among the total of 80 mother nests, 20 have been upgraded to one-star.

The Zerg territory is temporarily arranged like this, and it will be adjusted every day according to the actual situation.

Wu Qing looked at the number of two-star creatures killed required for the mother nest to upgrade, and it became 6 at this time, indicating that in today's battle, the Zerg killed a total of 5 two-star enemies.

The system does not count the number of one-star creatures killed. On the battlefield, one-star troops that are not large-scale can play a small role, and there is not much difference between them and ordinary troops in front of the Zerg.

Unless it is a large-scale elite one-star army like the Bear Goblin Dragoons, then the strength has changed qualitatively. Zerg puppies with several times the strength are estimated to be unable to stop the charge of those Dragoons.

Leaving everything to the supervision of the Queen of the Bugs, Wu Qing went to rest with peace of mind. After a busy day, his spirit was also a little tired.

…

Early the next morning, consuming 100 energy points, 10 points of Qi and a larva, 100 parasites were born.

This kind of parasite can enter the brain of intelligent creatures, replace part of the brain's functions, and control the brain.

The parasitized creatures have the characteristics of the Zerg, and their physique and strength will be enhanced. The parasites that have merged with the host can also continuously evolve and upgrade through the energy and luck of the host, and then feed back to the host, and achieve mutual success.
